import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    q = next(it)

    pref = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        pref[i] = pref[i - 1] + next(it)

    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        l = next(it)

        s = pref[r] - pref[l - 1]
        ans = 11 * (r - l) * s
